title: For what often comes next, ego is the enemy...
coreMove: Prepare for the fall while things still look strong, so failure does not get to define the next posture.
sourcePressure: Success section: Success-stage interstitial pivot toward failure. Supported by frozen TOC and book skeleton; no per-chapter source sidecar exists in the latest run.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating it as ominous filler rather than a precise bridge from distortion in success to distortion in failure.
sourceAnchorNote: No named person, study, place, or artifact is available in the frozen source sidecar for this chapter; use fictional scenarios only and do not invent source anecdotes.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
